distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) reported Liaoning, including Anshan in the 1984 source. Beaver & Liu (2010) documented Taiwan material from Hsinchu, Kinmen and Taipei (Xizhi) and used the broad mainland term China (NE); Yang (2020) also lists Liaoning and Taiwan. No further province is inferred from China (NE). Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Shandong as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) reported Pinus thunbergii. Beaver & Liu (2010) listed Pinus spp. without identifying additional species; this genus-level host evidence is retained without further inference.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus fulvus Niisima, 1908.

taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 39.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus fulvus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus fulvus Niisima, 1908, VSN_1699. 殷蕙芬等 (1984), 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) all use Cryphalus fulvus with authorship Niisima. A previous profile record gave authorship Eichhoff, 1878 was inconsistent with the integrated taxonomic backbone and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
